attributes.action: Explore with authorities celebrating Larry the Cat with Parliament Square statue
attributes.additional_details:
44% of Britons have a favourable opinion of Chief Mouser to the Cabinet Office Larry the cat. Awareness is high, 38% of the British public say they have heard a great deal about the Number 10 cat.(Ipsos)

Larry's consistent presence has brought comfort and joy to many. 
Please recognise Larry's significance on British History.
Improve the diversity of statues in Parliament Square. 
Demonstrate the British public value animals' labour. 
Celebrate Larry's life as an adoption success story.
attributes.background: Larry's been a dedicated civil servant outlasting six British prime ministers since 2011. Install a Larry statue in Parliament Square. It would be timeless, bipartisan, and connect with generations. Larry's rescue and life is a story of hope. Recognise Larry's contributions for his 20th birthday.

rejection.details:
We can't accept petitions about local issues.

Parliament Square Garden is managed by the Greater London Authority, which is responsible for decisions about installing statues there. You could contact the Mayor of London about your proposal:

https://www.london.gov.uk/contact-us
